about.highlight: We are a company specialized in the design, installation and maintenance of photovoltaic and solar thermal systems.
about.text: We offer sustainable, efficient and customized energy solutions for homes, businesses and institutions. Soltherra supports its clients from engineering through commissioning, ensuring regulatory compliance, economic savings and a lower environmental impact.

mission-vision.label: Mission and vision
mission-vision.mission: To provide sustainable energy solutions through photovoltaic and solar thermal systems, contributing to economic savings, caring for the environment and the well-being of communities, with a reliable, innovative and high-quality service.
mission-vision.vision: To be a leading clean energy company in Colombia, recognized for its commitment to sustainability, technological innovation and the positive transformation of homes, businesses and communities toward a responsible energy future.

steps.title: The sun arrives
steps.text: Solar radiation strikes the modules installed on your roof.

steps.title: The panel converts it
steps.text: Photovoltaic cells transform light into electricity.

steps.title: The inverter adapts it
steps.text: The inverter transforms the energy coming from the panels so it can be fed to the equipment in your home, business or institution, and to pour the surplus into the power grid.

steps.title: Your home lights up
steps.text: You use clean energy and depend less on the power grid.

steps.title: Engineering
steps.text: We analyze your energy needs, voltage levels and the existing electrical infrastructure to design your ideal solution.

steps.title: Procedures
steps.text: We manage availability with the grid operator and handle the government tax benefits for you.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: We carry out the implementation, mounting and safe commissioning of your photovoltaic solar system.

steps.title: Monitoring
steps.text: We supervise the performance and energy generation of your system in real time through our mobile app.

steps.title: Maintenance
steps.text: We provide continuous preventive and corrective maintenance to ensure the maximum operating efficiency of your system.

sections.title: Who is responsible
sections.text: Soltherra S.A.S., {{address}}. Email for personal data matters:

sections.title: What data we use and why
sections.text: Only what you write in the contact form: your name, the service you are interested in and, if you wish, a message. We use it solely to reply to you and send you a quote.

sections.title: Where your data ends up
sections.text: This page does not store what you write. When you submit the form, WhatsApp opens with your message already written, and you are the one who sends it. From that moment the message is handled by WhatsApp under its own terms, and we keep it in our WhatsApp only for the time needed to assist you.

sections.title: Consent
sections.text: Before submitting the form you must check the authorization box. Without it, no message is generated. You can withdraw your authorization at any time.

sections.title: Cookies and measurement
sections.text: We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. We measure visits with Google Analytics, which counts page views in aggregate, without cookies and without identifying you. The map on the contact page is loaded by Google Maps.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can access, update, rectify and request that we delete your data, and revoke your authorization (Law 1581 of 2012). Write to us at
sections.after: and we will reply within a maximum of fifteen business days. You can also go to the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce.
